items.resolution: ANA-01 adjacency: a catalog field code shared with an occupation or industry ID remains a separate field-of-study concept.
items.probe: When two things are exactly equal or just touch, do they merge, collide, or separate?

items.resolution: ANA-01 empty: a computed suppressed public record produces a visible null cell with its actual reason rather than an invented field value; an absent computation blocks.
items.probe: What is the result for empty, single-element, or null input?

items.resolution: ANA-01 encoding: official CMPE labels and normalized six-digit keys remain linked; blank and 999999 stay unknown, never named fields.
items.probe: Whose definition of length/equality applies — bytes, code points, grapheme clusters, or normalized form?
